{\n489\t            // Seconds\n490\t            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n491\t        };\n492\t        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n493\t    }\n494\t\n495\t    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n496\t    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n497\t        return Ok(dt);\n498\t    }\n499\t\n500\t    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n501\t        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n502\t        ts_str\n503\t    )))\n504\t}\n505\t\n506\t/// Extract a field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n507\t///\n508\t/// **Envelope-first with payload fallback for caret-prefixed paths:**\n509\t/// - If path starts with `^`, try envelope first (remove `^` prefix)\n510\t/// - If envelope is None OR field not found in envelope, fallback to payload\n511\t/// - Otherwise, extract from payload only\n512\t///\n513\t/// **Resolution order for `^field`:**\n514\t/// 1. Try `envelope.field` (if envelope exists)\n515\t/// 2. Fallback to `payload.field` (if envelope missing or field not found)\n516\t/// 3. Return None (if both fail)\n517\t///\n518\t/// **Resolution order for `field` (no caret):**\n519\t/// - Extract from `payload.field` only\n520\t///\n521\t/// Supports dot notation for nested fields (e.g., `^outer.ts` or `user.role`)\n522\t/// and array indexing (e.g., `items[0].name`).\n523\tpub fn extract_with_envelope(\n524\t    path: &str,\n525\t    payload: &Value,\n526\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n527\t) -> Option<Value> {\n528\t    if has_caret_prefix(path) {\n529\t        // Strip the caret prefix\n530\t        if let Some(envelope_path) = path.strip_prefix('^') {\n531\t            // Try envelope first\n532\t            if let Some(env) = envelope {\n533\t                if let Some(value) = extract_field(env, envelope_path) {\n534\t                    return Some(value); // Found in envelope\n535\t                }\n536\t            }\n537\t            // Fallback to payload (using path without ^)\n538\t            extract_field(payload, envelope_path)\n539\t        } else {\n540\t            // Should not happen due to starts_with check, but handle defensively\n541\t            None\n542\t        }\n543\t    } else {\n544\t        // No caret prefix - extract from payload only\n545\t        extract_field(payload, path)\n546\t    }\n547\t}\n548\t\n549\t/// Extract a string field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n550\t///\n551\t/// Wrapper around `extract_with_envelope` that converts the raw `Value` to a string,\n552\t/// following the same coercion rules as `extract_string` (String, Number, Bool, Null).\n553\tpub fn extract_string_with_envelope(\n554\t    path: &str,\n555\t    payload: &Value,\n556\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n557\t) -> Option<String> {\n558\t    let value = extract_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)?;\n559\t    match value {\n560\t        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n561\t        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n562\t        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n563\t        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n564\t        Value::Array(arr) => {\n565\t            // Handle content arrays (e.g., Claude Code format with text blocks and tool calls)\n566\t            // Extract text from all text blocks in the array\n567\t            let text_parts: Vec<String> = arr\n568\t                .iter()\n569\t                .filter_map(|item| {\n570\t                    if let Some(obj) = item.as_object() {\n571\t                        // Check for text blocks: {\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"...\"}\n572\t                        if obj.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n573\t                            return obj\n574\t                                .get(\"text\")\n575\t                                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n576\t                                .map(|s| s.to_string());\n577\t                        }\n578\t                    }\n579\t                    None\n580\t                })\n581\t                .collect();\n582\t            if text_parts.is_empty() {\n583\t                None\n584\t            } else {\n585\t                Some(text_parts.join(\" \"))\n586\t            }\n587\t        }\n588\t        _ => None,\n589\t    }\n590\t}\n591\t\n592\t/// Parse a timestamp from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n593\t///\n594\t/// Wrapper around `extract_string_with_envelope` that parses the extracted string\n595\t/// as a timestamp. Supports ISO 8601, Unix epoch (seconds/milliseconds), and\n596\t/// UTC-naive formats.\n597\tpub fn parse_timestamp_with_envelope(\n598\t    path: &str,\n599\t    payload: &Value,\n600\t    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n601\t) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n602\t    let ts_str = extract_string_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)\n603\t        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n604\t\n605\t    // Try ISO 8601 first\n606\t    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n607\t        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n608\t    }\n609\t\n610\t    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n611\t    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n612\t        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n613\t            // Milliseconds\n614\t            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n615\t        } else {\n616\t            // Seconds\n617\t            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n618\t        };\n619\t        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n620\t    }\n621\t\n622\t    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n623\t    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n624\t        return Ok(dt);\n625\t    }\n626\t\n627\t    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n628\t        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n629\t        ts_str\n630\t    )))\n631\t}\n632\t\n633\t/// Base trait for all format parsers\n634\tpub trait FormatParser {\n635\t    /// Parse events from the source\n636\t    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>>;\n637\t\n638\t    /// Parse events from the source, starting from a given byte offset for incremental parsing.\n639\t    ///\n640\t    /// For formats that support incremental parsing (JSONL, append-only logs), this allows\n641\t    /// the parser to skip already-processed content and only parse new data.\n642\t    ///\n643\t    /// # Arguments\n644\t    ///\n645\t    /// * `source_path` - Path to the source file\n646\t    /// * `plugin` - Plugin configuration for this source\n647\t    /// * `start_offset` - Byte offset to start reading from (0 for full parse)\n648\t    ///\n649\t    /// # Returns\n650\t    ///\n651\t    /// - `Ok(events)` - Vector of parsed events\n652\t    /// - `Err(_)` - Parse error (check `is_skippable()` for non-fatal errors)\n653\t    fn parse_incremental(\n654\t        &self,\n655\t        source_path: &Path,\n656\t        plugin: &Plugin,\n657\t        start_offset: u64,\n658\t    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n659\t        // Default implementation falls back to full parse\n660\t        let _ = start_offset; // Suppress unused warning\n661\t        self.parse(source_path, plugin)\n662\t    }\n663\t\n664\t    /// Detect session boundaries in the source\n665\t    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>>;\n666\t}\n667\t\n668\t/// Information about a detected session\n669\t#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n670\t#[allow(dead_code)]\n671\tpub struct SessionInfo {\n672\t    pub session_id: String,\n673\t    pub start_offset: u64,\n674\t    pub end_offset: u64,\n675\t    pub metadata: Option<Value>,\n676\t    /// Parent session ID (populated for subagent sessions where this session\n677\t    /// is a child of another session)\n678\t    pub parent_session_id: Option<String>,\n679\t}\n680\t\n681\t#[cfg(test)]\n682\tmod tests {\n683\t    use super::*;\n684\t    use serde_json::json;\n685\t\n686\t    // Tests for Import and ImportType         let index: usize = index_str.parse().ok()?;\n\n            current = current.get(key)?.get(index)?;\n        } else {\n            current = current.get(part)?;\n        }\n    }\n .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n\n    // Try ISO 8601 first\n    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n        return     return Ok(dt);\n    }\n\n    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n        ts_str\n    )))\n}\n\n/// Extract a field from either envelope or payload Try `envelope.field` (if envelope exists)\n/// 2. Fallback to `payload.field` (if envelope missing or field not found)\n/// 3. Return None (if both fail)\n///\n/// **Resolution order for `field` (no caret):**\n/// - Extract from `payload.field` only\n///\n/// Supports dot notation for nested fields (e.g., `^outer.ts` or `user.role`)\n/// and array indexing (e.g., `items[0].name`).\npub fn extract_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Option<Value> {\n    if has_caret_prefix(path) {\n        // Strip the caret prefix\n        if let Some(envelope_path) = path.strip_prefix('^') {\n            // Try envelope first\n            if let Some(env) = envelope {\n                if let Some(value) = extract_field(env, envelope_path) {\n                    return Some(value); // Found in envelope\n                }\n            }\n            // Fallback to payload (using path without ^)\n            extract_field(payload, envelope_path)\n        } else {\n            // Should not happen due to starts_with check, but handle defensively\n            None\n        }\n    } else {\n        // No caret prefix - extract from payload only\n        extract_field(payload, path)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Extract a string field from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// Wrapper around `extract_with_envelope` that converts the raw `Value` to a string,\n/// following the same coercion rules as `extract_string` (String, Number, Bool, Null).\npub fn extract_string_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Option<String> {\n    let value = extract_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)?;\n    match value {\n        Value::String(s) => Some(s),\n        Value::Number(n) => Some(n.to_string()),\n        Value::Bool(b) => Some(b.to_string()),\n        Value::Null => Some(String::new()),\n        Value::Array(arr) => {\n            // Handle content arrays (e.g., Claude Code format with text blocks and tool calls)\n            // Extract text from all text blocks in the array\n            let text_parts: Vec<String> = arr\n                .iter()\n                .filter_map(|item| {\n                    if let Some(obj) = item.as_object() {\n                        // Check for text blocks: {\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"...\"}\n                        if obj.get(\"type\").and_then(|t| t.as_str()) == Some(\"text\") {\n                            return obj\n                                .get(\"text\")\n                                .and_then(|t| t.as_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string());\n                        }\n                    }\n                    None\n                })\n                .collect();\n            if text_parts.is_empty() {\n                None\n            } else {\n                Some(text_parts.join(\" \"))\n            }\n        }\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Parse a timestamp from either envelope or payload based on path prefix\n///\n/// Wrapper around `extract_string_with_envelope` that parses the extracted string\n/// as a timestamp. Supports ISO 8601, Unix epoch (seconds/milliseconds), and\n/// UTC-naive formats.\npub fn parse_timestamp_with_envelope(\n    path: &str,\n    payload: &Value,\n    envelope: Option<&Value>,\n) -> Result<DateTime<Utc>> {\n    let ts_str = extract_string_with_envelope(path, payload, envelope)\n        .ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\"Field '{}' not found\", path)))?;\n\n    // Try ISO 8601 first\n    if let Ok(dt) = DateTime::parse_from_rfc3339(&ts_str) {\n        return Ok(dt.with_timezone(&Utc));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing as Unix epoch (seconds)\n    if let Ok(seconds) = ts_str.parse::<i64>() {\n        let ts = if seconds > 1_000_000_000_000 {\n            // Milliseconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp_millis(seconds)\n        } else {\n            // Seconds\n            DateTime::from_timestamp(seconds, 0)\n        };\n        return ts.ok_or_else(|| AgentScribeError::Timestamp(\"Invalid timestamp\".to_string()));\n    }\n\n    // Try parsing without timezone (assume UTC)\n    if let Ok(dt) = ts_str.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>() {\n        return Ok(dt);\n    }\n\n    Err(AgentScribeError::Timestamp(format!(\n        \"Cannot parse timestamp: {}\",\n        ts_str\n    )))\n}\n\n/// Base trait for all format parsers\npub trait FormatParser {\n    /// Parse events from the source\n    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>>;\n\n    /// Parse events from the source, starting from a given byte offset for incremental parsing.\n    ///\n    /// For formats that support incremental parsing (JSONL, append-only logs), this allows\n    /// the parser to skip already-processed content and only parse new data.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `source_path` - Path to the source file\n    /// * `plugin` - Plugin configuration for this source\n    /// * `start_offset` - Byte offset to start reading from (0 for full parse)\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// - `Ok(events)` - Vector of parsed events\n    /// - `Err(_)` - Parse error (check `is_skippable()` for non-fatal errors)\n    fn parse_incremental(\n        &self,\n        source_path: &Path,\n        plugin: &Plugin,\n        start_offset: u64,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        // Default implementation falls back to full parse\n        let _ = start_offset; // Suppress unused warning\n        self.parse(source_path, plugin)\n    }\n\n    /// Detect session boundaries in the source\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>>;\n}\n\n/// Information about a detected session\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\n#[allow(dead_code)]\npub struct SessionInfo {\n    pub session_id: String,\n    pub start_offset: u64,\n    pub end_offset: u64,\n    pub metadata: Option<Value>,\n    /// Parent session ID (populated for subagent sessions where this session\n    /// is a child of another session)\n    pub parent_session_id: Option<String>,\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde_json::json;\n\n    // Tests for Import and ImportType types\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_import_type_creation() {\n
